app_fee.value: Nonrefundable application fee of $50 USD for both Doctoral Applicants and International Applicants ($30 USD for domestic Master's/Specialist applicants).
app_fee.quote: Pay the nonrefundable application fee of $30 for U.S. Applicants, $50 for International Applicants, or $50 for Doctoral Applicants to Graduate School Admissions.

fee_waiver.value: No graduate application fee waiver policy is stated on A-State's HTML Graduate Admissions pages or Graduate Bulletin (all listed applications require the nonrefundable fee before processing).

gre_general.value: GRE requirements are set by each graduate program (see program overrides); many master's programs do not require GRE scores, while both STEM Ph.D. programs in the 2026-2027 Graduate Bulletin list GRE scores as required.

toefl_min.value: Minimum TOEFL iBT score of 79 (or IELTS 6.0 / Duolingo 120 / PTE 56); institutional ETS code 6011. (Older individual Ph.D. program pages still mention the legacy CBT 213 equivalent.)

ielts_min.value: Minimum IELTS score of 6.0 for international graduate applicants.

english_waiver.value: Citizens of listed English-speaking countries (excluding India) are exempt, and applicants who completed at least two years and graduated from a university in the USA, UK, Canada (except Quebec), Australia, or New Zealand are waived; applicants from India, Nepal, and Pakistan can satisfy English proficiency with 65% in English at Class X and Class XII.
english_waiver.quote: High School Marks (India, Nepal and Pakistan) 65% in English at X and XII in Certificate

notes: 2026-2027 Graduate Bulletin lists 3 Ph.D. programs total: Environmental Sciences, Molecular Biosciences, and Heritage Studies (humanities, excluded). ETS institutional code: 6011.
